summary.business_type: publisher / travel guide (Uganda destination guides + enquiry CTA)
top_findings: Production NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL has a trailing space, poisoning sitemap, robots, canonicals, OG/Twitter, and JSON-LD
Google/Bing site: queries show no indexed coverage for trip-insights.com
Canonical and og:url resolve to double-prefixed garbage URLs
Strong destination content (E-E-A-T) but almost no diaspora-intent pages
Brand collision risk with trip-insight.com (Japan tours)
quick_wins: Trim NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Vercel env and redeploy
Resubmit clean sitemap in Google Search Console
Rewrite homepage title/meta for Uganda travel + diaspora intent
Add alt text to destination card images
Publish one diaspora pillar: EAC/citizen rates, homecoming itineraries, flying-in from UK/US/UAE

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt allows Googlebot and major AI search crawlers
Next.js prerender for destination pages (Vercel HIT)

findings.title: Trailing space in SITE_URL breaks discovery
findings.description: Live robots.txt declares Sitemap: https://trip-insights.com /sitemap.xml. Every sitemap <loc> includes a space after the host. This matches NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL with a trailing space in production.
findings.recommendation: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://trip-insights.com (no trailing slash or space), trim in lib/site.ts as defense-in-depth, redeploy, validate sitemap locs.

findings.title: Canonical and Open Graph URLs are invalid
findings.description: Destination pages emit canonical/og:url like https://trip-insights.com/https:/trip-insights.com%20/uganda/bwindi-buhoma because Next metadataBase concatenates onto a broken absolute URL.
findings.recommendation: Fix SITE_URL, then verify canonical equals https://trip-insights.com/uganda/{slug} with no double host.

findings.title: Near-zero search index coverage
findings.description: site:trip-insights.com returned no usable Google or Bing results at audit time. Broken sitemap/canonicals are the leading hypothesis.
findings.recommendation: After URL fix: GSC property verify, submit sitemap, Inspect URL for homepage + Bwindi, request indexing.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Destination guides are deep, firsthand, dated (last checked), with local tips attributed (e.g. Winnie)
About page names George (Kampala-based guide) and Winnie (editor) — strong Who/How/Why
Practical logistics: sectors, permits, packing, stays by budget, food, FAQs

findings.title: Diaspora search intent is underserved
findings.description: Competitors already rank for Ugandan diaspora safaris, EAC citizen gorilla rates, and African diaspora tourism. Trip Insights content reads as general traveler guides, not returnee/diaspora planning.
findings.recommendation: Add a /guides/diaspora (or similar) hub covering passport/citizen rates, typical trip lengths from UK/US/UAE/Canada, family + safari combos, and WhatsApp planning CTA.

findings.title: Homepage is a destination grid, not a brand/SEO entry
findings.description: H1 focuses on Uganda destinations but title/meta stay generic. Thin for brand queries and tourism head terms.
findings.recommendation: Add a short intro block targeting Uganda travel planning for visitors abroad; keep the grid as the visual browse layer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Destination titles are keyword-rich (e.g. Bwindi gorillas stays tips)
Destination meta descriptions are specific and useful

findings.title: Homepage title/description lack tourism keywords
findings.description: Title is only 'Trip Insights'. Description is 'Best travel times, rough costs and local tips for every destination.' — no Uganda, safari, diaspora, or gorilla terms.
findings.recommendation: Example: 'Uganda Travel Guides for Diaspora & Global Travellers | Trip Insights' + meta naming costs, best times, gorilla/wildlife planning.

findings.title: Brand confusion with trip-insight.com
findings.description: Web search for brand-like queries surfaces the Japan operator trip-insight.com (singular). Your plural domain is invisible.
findings.recommendation: Strengthen unique brand phrases: 'Trip Insights Uganda', Kampala-based guide George, consistent NAP/sameAs; consider Organization schema + Wikipedia/LinkedIn entity clarity.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Destination pages emit Organization, WebSite, TouristDestination, BreadcrumbList, WebPage, optional FAQPage/Person

findings.title: All schema URLs inherit the trailing space
findings.description: JSON-LD url/logo/item fields use https://trip-insights.com /… which validators treat as invalid.
findings.recommendation: Fix SITE_URL; retest with Rich Results Test / Schema Validator.

findings.title: TouristDestination and breadcrumb paths omit /uganda
findings.description: Schema url uses SITE/slug instead of SITE/uganda/slug; breadcrumbs duplicate place names incorrectly.
findings.recommendation: Align schema URLs with real routes; Home → Uganda → Destination.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Destination HTML is prerendered and CDN-cached on Vercel
Images use loading=lazy on homepage cards

findings.title: PageSpeed API quota exhausted — lab CWV not measured
findings.description: Google PageSpeed Insights API returned 429; field CrUX not available without GSC/API credentials.
findings.recommendation: Run PSI manually for mobile LCP/INP/CLS after the URL fix; prefer field data in GSC.

findings.title: Homepage Cache-Control: private, no-store
findings.description: Homepage is not CDN-cacheable like destination pages, which can hurt TTFB for crawlers and users.
findings.recommendation: Align home with ISR/public cache where personalization is not required.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended allowed
Destination prose is highly citable (facts, FAQs, dates, named local tip)

findings.title: Brand invisibility limits AI citations
findings.description: AI Overviews/ChatGPT cite entities they already know. Zero index + weak brand mentions means low citation odds despite good guide copy.
findings.recommendation: Fix indexation first; then earn mentions on diaspora travel forums, LinkedIn, YouTube destination shorts.

findings.title: No llms.txt / missing Claude-SearchBot rule
findings.description: llms.txt is not a Google ranking factor; optional for agent discovery. Claude-SearchBot not listed separately from ClaudeBot.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add Claude-SearchBot allow; add llms.txt summarizing destinations after crawl works.

findings.title: Homepage destination images have empty alt
findings.description: 13/13 homepage tags audited had empty or missing meaningful alt (logo says 'Travel Guide' not Trip Insights).
findings.recommendation: Alt = destination name + activity cue, e.g. 'Mountain gorillas in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park'.

findings.title: OG image URL broken
findings.recommendation: After SITE_URL trim, use absolute https://trip-insights.com/logo/logo1.png or a proper 1200x630 social card.

findings.title: Double file extensions in media filenames
findings.description: URLs like .jpg.jpg and .webp.webp from Supabase storage.
findings.recommendation: Normalize upload pipeline to single extension.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Trim/fix NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Vercel; add .trim() in lib/site.ts
Redeploy; verify robots sitemap URL and all sitemap locs
Verify canonical + og:url + og:image on home and one destination
Submit sitemap + request indexing in Google Search Console

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rewrite homepage title/meta for Uganda + diaspora/global travellers
Fix schema paths (/uganda/slug) and breadcrumb hierarchy
Publish diaspora pillar page + internal links from destinations

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Cluster content: gorilla permits (citizen vs tourist), Entebbe logistics, family homecoming itineraries
Build brand mentions (LinkedIn company, YouTube, diaspora communities)
Expand beyond Uganda only when first country is ranking

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Track GSC impressions for diaspora/Uganda queries
Monitor index coverage and canonical errors
Re-run PSI for mobile CWV after media/alt pass
